aboutMe.subtitle: Who I am
aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.intro: Hi, I’m Dani. As a frontend developer and certified tax advisor with a research background, I’m fascinated by the intersection of tax law, education and technology. My Playground: TaxTech & EdTech.
aboutMe.residence: I’m based in the western part of Duisburg and open to project-based collaboration, both regionally and remotely.
aboutMe.openness: I enjoy learning new technologies and using them to develop suitable solutions for concrete challenges.
aboutMe.improve: I enjoy working through complex questions step by step and seeing every project as an opportunity to improve.
